arguments.sql: SELECT SUM(ol.quantity * p.unit_price) FROM order_lines ol JOIN orders o ON ol.order_id = o.id JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN products p ON ol.product_id = p.id WHERE c.name = 'Fonderie Vasseur SARL' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-12-31'
